events.title: Lynayly Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Experience a real-time cooperative roguelike deckbuilder where you can team up with friends or AI companions, build powerful decks, and battle through challenging encounters.We're excited to finally share Lynayly with you and would love to hear your feedback!🎮 Play the free demo and wishlist Lynayly on Steam!💬 Join our Discord for updates, patch notes, and feedback: https://discord.gg/CDfzEKZ8hThank you for supporting Lynayly!— Joyful Games
